content_fields.title: Trust forwarded headers only from known proxies behind TLS (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Derive the client address from forwarded headers only when the request arrives from a known proxy, and never make an authorization decision on it alone.
content_fields.finding: Authorization is decided from request.client.host alone, with no proxy allow-list and no validation of forwarded headers.
criteria: No route grants access based on request.client.host or an X-Forwarded-For value.
Forwarded headers are honoured only for source addresses in the configured proxy range.
